description: Explain one rule from archprint_scan in depth, by its id, label or ESLint name (e.g. AP-002, env-access, no-lib-to-app, "lib !-> app" or archprint/no-lib-to-app): its statement, gate status, adoption (enforce, review, or report-only, as in archprint_scan), observed conformance and confidence floor, and every file that breaks it (scan lists only a few). For the forbidden-import rules (AP-001, AP-002) it also returns each confidence-gate condition with its value and threshold, how to fix a violation, and when not to adopt the rule. A rule the team stated in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md and adopted (its id starts with doc-) comes back with the sentence the team wrote, its source line, what it enforces in plain words, its evidence and its exceptions. Read-only.

id.description: rule id, label or ESLint name from archprint_scan, e.g. AP-002, no-lib-to-app or "lib !-> app", or a declared rule id such as doc-no-fetch-in-components

path.description: app or monorepo-root directory on this machine (default "."), not a URL

name: archprint_explain
title: Explain an architecture rule
